name: No-Cream Shahi Paneer
steps: Blend the boiled onions, tomatoes, ginger and garlic to a smooth paste.
Heat the oil, crackle the cardamom and cloves, then pour in the paste. Cook on low heat for 8 minutes, stirring often.
Add coriander powder and ½ cup water, then stir in the yogurt off the heat to prevent curdling.
Whisk in the silken tofu and simmer gently for 3 minutes.
Add the paneer and garam masala, simmer for 2 minutes and season.
note: A mild, creamy Mughlai-style gravy without cream or nuts.
